feed.title: Chapter 5: Sequence Models, Transformers & LLMs — Civil Engineer's Guide to AI
feed.subtitle: Updates to Chapter 5 sub-lessons.

entry.title: 5.1 Sequence Models & RNNs
entry.summary: Understand sequence models and recurrent neural networks through a civil engineering lens. Explore RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs, and bidirectional architectures for sensor time series and specification text processing.

entry.title: 5.2 The Attention Mechanism
entry.summary: Understand the attention mechanism through a civil engineering lens. Explore Query, Key, Value vectors, scaled dot-product attention, and self-attention with interactive demos and analogies.

entry.title: 5.3 Transformer Architecture
entry.summary: Master the Transformer architecture through a civil engineering lens. Explore multi-head attention, positional encoding, encoder-decoder stacks, residual connections, and layer normalization with interactive demos.

entry.title: 5.4 BERT & Encoder Models
entry.summary: Explore BERT and encoder-only Transformer models through a civil engineering lens. Learn masked language modelling, next sentence prediction, fine-tuning, tokenization, and variants like RoBERTa, ALBERT, and DistilBERT with interactive demos.

entry.title: 5.5 GPT & Decoder Models
entry.summary: Explore GPT and decoder-only Transformer models through a civil engineering lens. Learn autoregressive generation, causal masking, temperature sampling, top-k/top-p, GPT evolution from GPT-1 to GPT-4, in-context learning, and few-shot prompting with interactive demos.

entry.title: 5.6 Tokenization & Embeddings
entry.summary: Learn how text is broken into tokens and mapped to numerical vectors. Explore BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece, Word2Vec, GloVe, contextual embeddings, positional encodings, and context windows with interactive demos and civil engineering analogies.

entry.title: 5.7 Fine-Tuning & Prompt Engineering
entry.summary: Master the two main strategies for adapting large language models to civil engineering tasks: fine-tuning model weights on domain data and crafting effective prompts. Covers LoRA, QLoRA, adapters, RLHF, zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought prompting, and CE-specific applications.

entry.title: 5.8 RAG & Knowledge Retrieval
entry.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for civil engineering: ground LLM outputs in building codes, project specifications, and safety manuals using embedding-based retrieval, vector databases, chunking strategies, and hybrid search.

entry.title: 5.9 LLM Limitations & Hallucinations
entry.summary: Understand the failure modes of large language models: hallucination, confabulation, sycophancy, reasoning errors, bias amplification, adversarial attacks, and civil-engineering-specific risks including fabricated code references and incorrect load calculations.

entry.title: 5.10 CE Case Study: AI-Assisted Design Review
entry.summary: End-to-end case study of using NLP and LLMs for AI-assisted structural design review in civil engineering: document ingestion, information extraction, code compliance checking, automated report generation, and human sign-off.
